versions.content: Name E2E_ P22Protect State Type Kind Structure Elements Counter Type uint8 Comment Counter to be used for protecting the Data. The initial value is 0, which means that the first Data will have the counter 0. After the protection by the counter, the counter is incremented modulo 16. Description State of the sender for a Data protect ed with E2E Profile 22. Available via E2E.h
